title: Upstream `mama` Autonomy Ledger (import interface)
description: The YAML Autonomy Ledger (upstream schema 2) as imported by mama-integrations, expressed in JSON form. Structural validation only — ledger health (coverage, staleness, expiry) remains upstream (ledger_health). Contract content passes through exactly as issued. Note: last_review <= horizon and the non-empty list rules are enforced by the adapter; JSON Schema expresses what it can.

schema.description: Ledger format version. 2 = supported. 1 = retired scale (imported with a loud warning; values on the retired 0-4 scale; re-baseline per upstream migration guidance). Absent = pre-versioning (warning). >=3 = fail closed.

id.description: Unique, stable; version the contract (-v2) rather than mutating history.

domain.description: Machine-friendly slug for the autonomy domain.

level.description: As issued by upstream. On schema 2: L0 Submarine Line (no grant) or L1-L5 definitive levels. Never edited by MAMA.

scope.description: Human sentence describing what is delegated.

guardrails.description: Non-empty — a contract without guardrails is not a contract.

grantor.description: Accountable holder of the grant (must not be the grantee).

horizon.description: ISO-8601 date; grant expires for review purposes.
